listing.name: BDS Bismarck
listing.summary: Adds a high-value, single-ship fleet substitute with massive armor, flux capacity, and a large array of weapon mounts.
listing.aiSummary: Adds a high-value, single-ship fleet substitute with massive armor, flux capacity, and a large array of weapon mounts.

description: Adds a powerful capital ship designed as a substitute for obsolete fleets. It features 1st grade armor, super-durable hull, high maneuverability, and monstrous flux capacity. The ship includes a vast array of small, medium, and large universal weapon mounts as well as missile batteries.
